description: A layout with plot settings in inches: ANSI B (11 by 17 inches, stored as 279.4 by 431.8 millimetres), no rotation, plot scale 1:96, margins 0.25 all round, plot origin (0.5, 0.75), lineweights printed and the acad.ctb style table named.
